# Requirements

The synthetic assistant answers policy questions from a tiny local retrieval corpus and returns structured evidence.

Acceptance criteria:

- AI/RAG behavior, prompt, model decision, retrieval, dataset, eval, grounding, safety, trace and cost artifacts are visible.
- Local smoke checks validate only static fixture structure and deterministic sample output.
- Live model/API/provider calls remain out of scope.

Non-goals:

- Do not prove answer quality.
- Do not prove grounding quality.
- Do not prove model safety.
- Do not prove real user value or release readiness.
